verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms an Expensify Card program exists and that cards carry "Smart Limits", which supports per-card spend controls. Nothing shows the founder actually issuing physical versus virtual cards to team members, or how fast that is. Other card material covers importing existing cards (BYOC), not issuing new ones. Missing for 10: explicit physical and virtual card issuance, evidence of issuing cards in minutes, per-cardholder limit configuration details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
